packageRules.description: A workflow file can hold secrets or write tokens, and the CLI smoke pins in .github/cli-smoke/ ran beside the smoke credentials until the credentialed legs were deleted on 2026-11-25, so bumps to them used to need a human approval (#6506 review-gates-15). Richard directed automerge for all Renovate updates on 2026-11-23, with CI as the gate, so these updates automerge like the rest. Renovate applies rules in order, so this rule sits after every rule that enables automerge.

The weekly lock file refresh of the CLI smoke lockfiles. This refresh used to need a human approval and a separate branch. Richard directed automerge for all Renovate updates on 2026-11-23, with CI as the gate, so these refreshes automerge on the shared lock file maintenance path like the repo root refreshes.

A feature or image bump must refresh devcontainer-lock.json in the same PR. These updates used to stay reviewable so the bump could not land alone and leave the lock stale. Richard directed automerge for all Renovate updates on 2026-11-23, with CI as the gate, so these updates automerge like the rest. This rule stays last on purpose: Renovate applies rules in order.
